html:
Cuban poet, journalist and organiser of the war for independence from Spain. He is the national hero of Cuba.

Born in Havana to Spanish parents, he was arrested at sixteen for opposing Spanish rule. He did hard labour in a quarry and was then exiled to Spain. He later lived in Mexico, Guatemala and Venezuela, and from 1881 mostly in New York.

From New York he wrote for newspapers across Latin America. His essay "Our America" (1891) urged Latin Americans to trust their own peoples and beware of the growing power of the United States. His Simple Verses (1891) helped start the modernismo movement in Spanish poetry, and lines from them became the song "Guantanamera".

In 1892 he founded the Cuban Revolutionary Party and united the exile groups behind a new war, with the generals Máximo Gómez and Antonio Maceo. The war began in 1895. Martí landed in Cuba and was killed in one of the first clashes, at Dos Ríos. Cuba's later leaders, including those of the Cuban Revolution, all claimed him.
sum: Cuban poet, journalist and organiser of the war for independence from Spain. He is the national hero of Cuba.
